t: When you have everything and still feel hollow
a: وَمَنْ أَعْرَضَ عَن ذِكْرِى فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ مَعِيشَةً ضَنكًا وَنَحْشُرُهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ أَعْمَىٰ
p: Wa man aʿraḍa ʿan dhikrī fa-inna lahu maʿīshatan ḍankā…
m: And whoever turns away from My remembrance - indeed, he will have a depressed [i.e., difficult] life, and We will gather [i.e., raise] him on the Day of Resurrection blind."
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
